record.title: Reconcile first physical identity with the firmware corpus
record.intent: Compare observed identity text with local firmware provenance without making another specimen request.
requirements: Preserve exact raw response privately and distinguish reported version from artifact byte identity; handle a negative result without inventing fields.
Record a redacted conclusion and remaining uncertainty, commit and push evidence and task state, then stop for operator review.
No further physical operation or successor physical task admission.
acceptance: The identity result is reconciled offline and the authorization boundary remains closed.
